related_questions.question: Can you get long covid if you're asymptomatic?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, it is possible to develop long COVID (also known as post-COVID conditions) even after an asymptomatic or mild COVID-19 infection. While long COVID is more commonly associated with severe acute infections, research has shown that individuals who experienced minimal or no symptoms during their initial COVID-19 illness can still develop long-term symptoms. These symptoms can range from fatigue and brain fog to more serious conditions like heart damage.
